ns2:section.sectionText: System engineering focuses on how to design and manage complex systems over their life cycles while reducing risk. This course will present an interdisciplinary engineering approach and means to enable the realization of quality products that meet user needs while considering both the business and the technical needs of all stakeholders.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Grainger Engineering. Restricted to Technical Systems Management major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
